exposure: uterine fibroids during pregnancy (size, number, location)
fibroid surgery before pregnancy (number of fibroids operated on)
cohort: The study included 338 women who had uterine fibroids during pregnancy or had undergone fibroid surgery before pregnancy, all of whom gave birth at a tertiary university hospital.
finding: The number, size, and placement of uterine fibroids, whether present during pregnancy or operated on before pregnancy, significantly influence perinatal outcomes such as gestational age, birth weight, and Apgar score.
mod_finding: Submucosal fibroids during pregnancy are associated with an increased chance of cesarean delivery.
